purpose: Promote genuinely inspected Indexed item pages so content work increases both content-readiness and canonical Verified counts.
source_policy: Authorized Chabad.org / TheRebbe.org item-level pages only. Store bounded non-verbatim research paraphrases and exact locators; do not copy protected full text.

verification_scope.living_torah: Nine authorized item-page attributed synopses/short excerpts and event metadata were inspected. The audiovisual recordings were not independently played or transcribed, so the stored Hebrew propositions are derived research paraphrases and not transcript witnesses.
verification_scope.letters: Five authorized Chabad.org / Sichos in English item-level translations were inspected. The Hebrew originals, incoming correspondence, manuscripts and secretariat copies were not independently inspected; the English translations are derived witnesses, not independent additional sources.

items.limitation: documents the report to the Rebbe, not a detailed Rebbe response

items.dedup_note: the separate Indexed alias was not promoted or counted as an independent witness

code_change: Metrics now publish content_verified_unique_sources separately and the hourly productivity snapshot tracks it, preventing content inspection from being hidden behind the broader bibliographic Verified total.
rights: Metadata, links and bounded non-verbatim research paraphrases only. No protected full text stored.
